label: LSM303 Compass
info: Reads acceleration, magnetic flux density, tilt-compensated heading and relative temperature from an LSM303 e-compass once a second. A function node formats the heading as a 16-point compass name and computes pitch and roll from the acceleration; a debug node shows the values. Demonstrates a tilt-compensated electronic compass. Adjust the accelerometer range / data rate and the magnetometer range / data rate in the device config node to match the application.

name: compass name + tilt
